newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel prices edge lower with futures.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel prices edge lower with futures.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices edged lower with NYMEX futures on Monday, players said, with differentials on aviation-quality 54-grade material little changed in both centers.

New York Harbor 54-grade fuel was offered at about 1.10 cents over November futures, slightly weaker than Friday diffs, while prompt Gulf material was steady at between 3.0 cents and 2.75 cents under December heat, traders said.
Gulf low sulfur 55-grade fuel slipped to about 2.0 cents below the print, a half cent weaker than Friday diffs, traders said.
